site.description: Signs that advertise the gospel on trucks
site.footerText: © Traveling Billboards. - Travel with the Gospel

hero.description: Let's spread the message of hope and faith across the highways. By putting the gospel on your tailgate, we can reach people on the road with a message of encouragement and inspiration. Join us in this journey to share the good news with travelers everywhere.

items.title: Inspiring Thoughts
items.description: We put thoughts related to each sign made. To share the gospel in new ways.

items.title: Curated Links
items.description: Handpicked resources and tools trusted on the journey.

items.title: Join the Journey
items.description: Be part of the movement to share the gospel on the road. Join us in spreading hope and faith. Join the Tailgate Club and add our signs to your tailgate, and help us reach more travelers with the message of the gospel.

thoughts.title: Roadside Thoughts
thoughts.subtitle: Each sign holds a deeper message tied to the Gospel. As you explore, leave a comment, join the Tailgates Club, and help us share the message along the road.
thoughts.noThoughtsMessage: No thoughts found for this sign.

qrModal.description: Every sign on a tailgate carries a story. Explore reflections, notes, and encouragement shared along the highway.

thoughts.thankYouMessage: Thanks for scanning the QR code!

hero.title: Questions

liveChatCard.title: Chat with a person
liveChatCard.description: Speak directly with someone who can help answer faith questions, explain Bible passages, and share encouragement.

messages.text: Hi there! How can we help with your question today?
I want a clear Bible answer and a friendly response.
Great! You can send your message here and we’ll reply in chat style.
